outcome: Changes in genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic profiles (multi-omics data)
Clinical data related to healing and resilience
Variations indicative of aberrant peri-operative outcomes
cohort: Patients undergoing 14 types of elective surgeries, selected to represent a range of injury locations and intensities.
finding: The study successfully established a prospective biospecimen repository for multi-omic and clinical data collection, demonstrating the feasibility of gathering high-quality longitudinal data and observing initial physiologic perturbations.
followup_time: Throughout the peri-operative period and recovery
